title: NeuralFlow Pipeline
description: Schema v2 for a NeuralFlow pipeline file. Loops are subgraphs, ports are typed, no secrets or device pins are stored. Fields will be fully specified in Phase 1 (P1 task).

schema_version.description: Pipeline format version. Must be '2.0' for schema v2.

version.description: Semantic version of this pipeline file (e.g. '1.0.0').

nodes.description: Ordered list of nodes in the pipeline graph. Fully specified in Phase 1.

items.description: Node definition — full schema filled in Phase 1.

loops.description: Loop subgraph definitions. Fully specified in Phase 1.

items.description: Loop definition — full schema filled in Phase 1.

edges.description: Directed edges between node ports. Fully specified in Phase 1.

items.description: Edge definition — full schema filled in Phase 1.

endpoints.description: Named endpoint registry. Keys are endpoint_ref strings used by model nodes. No secrets stored here — keys resolved at run time from OS keychain. Fully specified in Phase 1.

additionalProperties.description: Endpoint descriptor — full schema filled in Phase 1.
